method.projection: TF-IDF, centred PCA to 48 dimensions, cosine t-SNE to two dimensions
method.features: English L4 name (double weight) and definition; unigrams and bigrams; log TF; smoothed IDF; L2 normalisation
method.scenario_membership: Editorial, overlapping conditional applicability lenses; not an empirical incident classification
method.edge_rule: Up to three closest TF-IDF neighbours per card with cosine at least 0.30; ties may be fewer
method.limitations: t-SNE emphasises local text neighbourhoods. Global distances, cluster areas and axis values have no risk meaning. Neighbours do not imply causation, likelihood, severity, or validated deployment-specific relevance.

scenarios.name: Delivery robot services
scenarios.description: Mobile robots sharing pavements, entrances and public spaces with pedestrians. Includes fleet connectivity and public-space access.

scenarios.name: Humanoids in factories
scenarios.description: Humanoids working alongside people, manipulating tools and materials, and coordinating industrial tasks. Workplace monitoring is included conditionally.

scenarios.name: Household assistant humanoids
scenarios.description: Humanoids assisting with domestic tasks around people, fragile objects and private spaces. Relationship-related risks apply when a conversational interface is provided.

scenarios.name: Autonomous network operations agents
scenarios.description: Software agents diagnosing faults, using operational tools and changing network configurations. Multi-agent risks apply when operators deploy collaborating agents.
